services.name: Rhinoplasty

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Rhinoplasty improves the shape of the nose. It is more popularly called 'nose job' and is also one of the most common cosmetic surgeries performed around the world. The nose is a very prominent feature of the face and attracts a lot of attention when we interact with people. A crooked or deformed nose is a blow to one's confidence and one often spends a lot of time worrying about its shape and size. A nose surgery can correct most of the deformities in the nose and make a nose look more harmonious with one's face.

There are many myths surrounding this popular procedure and the most common among them is that an artificial material is used to change the shape of the nose and it gives an artificial look to the face. In reality, most of the rhinoplasties are done without using any kind of artificial material and the improvement in the shape of the nose comes from removing excess cartilage or adding cartilage where it is deficient, rasping down the bone and arranging and adjusting the tissues around for a better result. Most of the patients after a rhinoplasty gain back their lost confidence. Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya is an internationally trained plastic surgeon, offering the best rhinoplasty surgery while giving natural results.

sections.heading: When to Consider Nose Surgery
sections.body:
- If you are unhappy with the size of your nose or the shape then you can consider a Rhinoplasty.
- If you think that your nose doesn't suit your face or it is too large or too small.
- If you feel blocked while breathing and your nose becomes too stuffy and you feel this blockage too often.
- A nose hump is also a very common reason for which one seeks a rhinoplasty.
- If you feel that the nose tip is too bulky and lacks a refined shape.
- If you feel your nose is too broad and your nostrils are too wide.

sections.heading: What are my options?
sections.body:
The nose is usually approached in two manners: External and internal. Looking at the shape of your nose, your rhinoplasty surgeon would be the best person to decide the approach which is best suited to you for a natural result. Apart from the incisions, there are few other variations in the manner in which a rhinoplasty is done. Cartilage is often used from one's own nose to smoothen out irregularities and build up the nose. If the nose cartilage has already been utilized then ear cartilage or rib cartilage may have to be used to get the wanted results.

Silicone is also available for the nose to bring up a depressed nose but being a foreign material, it has the chance of getting infected and rejection. Thus, natural cartilage is the best option to get the required result. Sometimes, fillers or fat grafts may also be injected to smooth the nose, to camouflage deformities or indentations, or to add volume in the areas wherever it is being required. Rhinoplasty surgery offers you with desired results.

sections.heading: Open rhinoplasty
sections.body: During the procedure, a small incision is made on the underside of the nose which usually starts fading out with the moving time and heals in a short period of time. Open method is known as the popular method of doing a rhinoplasty because it gives a better view of the deformities and the correction is also achieved better with the open rhinoplasty method. However, the decision is actually taken by the professional rhinoplasty doctor after assessing the nose during the consultation.

sections.heading: Endonasal rhinoplasty
sections.body: In this method, the incision is inside the nose, offers limited visualization and is best suited for limited changes required for correction of nasal shape.

sections.heading: When to consider a Facelift?
sections.body:
Most patients consider a face lift when what they see in the mirror is not in sync with their youthfulness in spirit and energy.

- If you have loose sagging skin around your jowls, mid-face, and neck.
- If you have prominent nasolabial folds.
- If your face looks deflated and volume depleted.

- If you have a deep line extending from your angle of mouth to the chin (marionette lines).
- If you have a double chin along with loose neck skin.
- Even if you are just concerned about the loose neck, you are a good candidate.
- If you cannot identify with the old reflection of yours that you see in the mirror and you feel that age, heredity, sun-exposure, and gravity has started telling on your face.

sections.heading: What should I expect from my face lift procedure?
sections.body: This procedure will make you look younger, fresher, smoother and rejuvenated. It will eliminate all your major folds and wrinkles.

sections.heading: How is a face lift performed?
sections.body:
Majority of the face lift surgeries actually focus on the lower face. It can also focus on the midface and the forehead in the same surgery. This surgery is performed under general anesthesia or IV sedation with local anesthesia. An incision is placed in the hidden part of the face, along with the hairline and along the ear which goes back to the hairline. At this place, one will not be able to make out the scar eventually. This is also an area that can be camouflaged till the time the wound is healing. The skin envelope is lifted and the face and the neck muscles are tightened. The skin is redraped and the excess skin is taken off. The suture is done with either absorbable or removable sutures.

There are different approaches to a face lift but this is the most common one. Depending on your requirement, fat injections, fillers or implants may be needed to be added to the procedure. The goal of your Cosmetic Plastic surgeon is to give you a pleasing result with minimal downtime and well-concealed scars. There is usually a team to take care of your post-operative needs and everyone's goal is to make your rejuvenation journey comfortable and rewarding.

sections.heading: How will the incisions look like?
sections.body:
Almost all face lifts will have incisions that run around the front of the ear but they are all well concealed. The extent of the incisions may differ on the type of surgery being planned.

Your board certified Cosmetic Plastic Surgeon will make these incisions as hidden as possible and may customize the incisions according to the requirement. Scarring properties depend on a lot of factors. Wound infection, poor technique, increased tension, genetics, sun exposure can be important factors when the outcome of any scar is considered. This is no different with a face lift. Most of the people do not have noticeable scars in the long term.

- Traditional face lift: The incision will run from the temples, in front of the ear, back of the ear and disappears into the hairline at the back.
- Short scar face lift: This too starts at the temple, goes down to the front of the ear and just turns around the earlobe. There may be additional small incisions needed to access different areas if desired.
- Neck lift: This lift will need an incision in the front of the ear-lobe and behind the ear. You will also need to have an incision under the chin area to access the loose muscles of the neck.

sections.heading: Pros

sections.heading: Recovery Timeline
sections.body:
With more extensive procedures, the results last much longer. So, if you are prepared for some time off work and can afford the downtime associated, go by the advice of the Cosmetic Plastic Surgeon. Ask for the most suitable procedure and make out some time off your schedule for the recovery. Remember, we are talking about a procedure which has lasting results in terms of 10-15 years. A couple of weeks off will ensure that you have the most appropriate procedure.

- In the short term you can expect bruising and swelling that occurs after the surgery. This usually subsides quite a lot in the first week to ten days.
- You should avoid bending forwards with your head down and any strenuous activity for one month.
- Swimming should be avoided for the same duration too. You can start your routine activity after two days but have ample rest after your surgery.
- Joining back to work should be considered in a week to ten days time.
- You will also need to wear a compression wear around your chin which helps to take care of the swelling and helps in the draping of the skin to the underlying tissues.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Aging is a gradual process and no one can be exempted from this. Aging signs start appearing around our eyes first. Why? Because the skin around our eyes is thin as compared to the rest of the face and body. One will start noticing fine lines, loose and sagging upper lids, puffy eyes, and undereye bags. This is because the tissues lose elasticity over time and separate under the skin. As the skin is thin in this area, veins and scattered muscles are prominently visible.

Today we are always on the go, hardly getting enough sleep and rest. This can trigger premature aging of our skin. Blue light from the TV, computer and mobile screens as well as the lack of sleep put a lot of strain on our eyes, causing dark circles, under eye bags, and crow's feet. These often give a tired and dull appearance to the entire face.

sections.heading: Benefits & Expectations

- There is significant skin tightening and fat reduction.
- You will get a beautiful jawline.
- There is some downtime required in case of surgical techniques. But for most of the mentioned procedures patients can resume work immediately.

sections.heading: Possible Side Effects

sections.heading: Facelift Surgery
sections.body: When there is prominent sagging in the midface and lower face region then Facelift surgery can be the right treatment for the patients. Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya often combines fat grafting along with Facelift to transfer fat, let's say from the double chin to the area around the cheekbone or on the chin. This will revolumize the sunken areas on the face, balance the features and give a younger look. An incision is made around the ears. Fat is removed, muscles are tightened and excess skin is removed. This can correct loose jowls, double chin, neck folds, lines and wrinkles on the face. These incisions are mindfully made to be virtually invisible.

sections.heading: Liposuction
sections.body: Liposuction is a surgical, advanced procedure done to suck out the extra fat from an area for a slim look. This was done earlier for body contouring but today smaller cannulas are made for face contouring. Fat breaking fluid is injected in the underchin region. One small incision is made under the chin to insert the cannula. It is then moved around to break the fat deposition on the underlying muscles and is sucked out. Liposuction has given good results for double chin reduction as the plastic surgeon has complete control over the shaping of this area. Results are permanent, but stuffing the body with junk food and no physical activities will make double chin appear again.

sections.heading: Cryosculpting
sections.body: The FDA approved Ultherapy/ Cryosculpting technology can also be used for the Chin Lift treatment. It is a painless method to contour the jawline and chin region. This will freeze the fat cells, bring about cell death and naturally removes them through urine after the Cryosculpting. There is significant tightening after this non-invasive treatment. However, patients may need up to 6-8 sessions to see the complete transformation.

sections.heading: Deoxycholic Acid
sections.body: Deoxycholic Acid is a bile acid made in our body to break down fat for their complete digestion. When Deoxycholic Acid is injected in an area it performs the same function. This is a non-invasive option for reducing double chin and the extra layer of fat around the jawline. Markings are made on the treatment area and series of injections are given for good results. Patients might need 2-3 sessions to completely melt the fat layer.

sections.heading: High Intensity Focussed Ultrasound (HIFU)
sections.body: High Intensity Focussed Ultrasound (HIFU) tightens the skin, improves the collagen and blood circulation in the double chin area. As there is not enough blood circulation in this region, the body can't break down this fat. The ultrasound energy slightly injures your tissues which triggers body's repair mechanism. There is more blood flow, more oxygen, and more collagen production. Your body is going to use that fat and eliminate the residue naturally.

Generally, both the lips are reduced to bring the lips in proportion, but the significant reduction is in the lower lip. It is specifically to take care of the outward turned lower lip.

sections.heading: Permanent Procedure
sections.body: Unlike lip augmentation, lip reduction is a one-time procedure. It does not include additional touch-ups to maintain the result. The scar line settles well and is most often at the junction between the dry and the wet vermilion.

sections.heading: Lip Enhancement with filler/ surgery
sections.body:
Fillers are the most popular technique to plump up the thin lips. These are also a great option for shaping up the lips. One can expect a perfect pout using fillers. The fillers last up to a year, and a touch up is needed to maintain it at the same level.

Lip fillers are an office procedure, and it takes about 15 mins to execute an ideal lip enhancement. The swelling from the procedure mainly subsides in a few hours to 2 days.

sections.heading: Surgical lip enhancement with fat

Lips are also sometimes augmented with fat. This is a lasting procedure and it is tough to reverse the plumped up lips after fat grafting.

To get a significant enhancement, the individual needs to undergo the procedure again because when fat is injected from one place to another some of the fat is absorbed.

The procedure is mostly carried out under local anesthesia, but sometimes sedation in line with local anesthesia is also used to make the patient more comfortable.

Overall, the procedure takes around 30 minutes, and no cuts are made to harvest or inject the fat. The whole process is performed using injections.

sections.heading: Why Consider Surgery?
sections.body:
To provide the best breast augmentation surgery using Breast implants, the first step is to discuss why one needs the surgery. Some of the reasons for which individuals consider Breast implant surgery are when one wants to:

- Have a better-proportioned figure that is appealing.
- Reconstruct an absent chest either congenitally or due to a chest removal surgery (Mastectomy).
- If you want a better proportioned or more appealing figure and want clothes to fit better.
- To restore the shape when one chest looks a lot different from the other.
- When aging, chestfeeding, pregnancy or weight loss has affected the appearance of the chests.

sections.heading: Procedure of Breast Implant Surgery
sections.body:
Breast augmentation surgery using Breast implants done by Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya is a multi-step procedure. In this procedure, the surgeon will make an incision and place the implants in a pocket underneath the chest tissue. The implants are then placed in this tissue and the incision is closed, most commonly with absorbable sutures.

The different types of incisions in practice that can be made to place the implants are:

The planes where the implants can be placed under the chest may be behind the gland or the muscle. The surgeon is the best person to suggest where should the implants be placed depending on certain factors that are best discussed after the physical examination.

- Inframammary: In the chest crease underneath the chest.
- Transaxillary: Near the arm pit.
- Periareolar: Halfway around the black area surrounding the nipple.
- Transumbilical: In the belly button/navel (Only for Saline implants).

sections.heading: Most Common Reasons
sections.body:
- When a woman feels that her chests are too small for her body.
- When clothes fit perfectly at the hips but are loose on the top.
- When one wants to have a shapely figure while wearing a swim-suit or low neckline dresses and have firm chests.
- When one wants to regain the pre-pregnancy shape of the body.
- When one suffers from Poland Syndrome where one chest is absent or very small in comparison to the other chest.

sections.heading: Types of Implants
sections.body:
There have never been more choices for Breast implants. The following options are available, depending on your medical history, body shape and aesthetic goals:

- Silicone Breast implants (gel-filled): These are the most commonly used Breast implants throughout the world. They are pre-filled with soft silicone gel in a silicone shell.
- Silicone Breast implants (cohesive gel): These are pre-filled implants also called as gummy-bear or form-stable implants. The silicone gel used in these implants is more form-stable.
- Saline Breast implants: These implants have sterile salt water filled in them instead of silicone. They may be pre-filled or may be inflated after the implant has been placed in the pocket of the chest, hence the incision used for their placement is smaller than the silicone implant.

sections.heading: How Do I Prepare?
sections.body:
Once you have had a consult with Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya, you would most likely be advised:

- A baseline mammogram or an ultrasound of the chests
- To quit smoking or at least stop it a couple of weeks before and after the surgery.
- To stop taking any blood thinners if you take it or to stop certain drugs that cause blood thinning.
- To keep up the water intake.

sections.heading: Implant with Fat
sections.body: In this method, the fat from one's own body (e.g. the thighs, the abdomen or the buttock) is used. The fat is harvested by the method of liposuction, filtered and purified for injection and the fat is inserted at different planes of the chest through injections. This can be considered a virtually scar-less technique. A chest lift may be combined with any of these procedures if the chests are droopy and need a lift as well as volume.

sections.heading: Are Breast Implants Safe?
sections.body: The USFDA has approved the usage of silicone implants in chest enhancement surgeries. It is important for women having Breast implants to know that although the implants last quite long, it may need to be replaced. One must stay in touch with her aesthetic surgeon to have periodic examinations and checks.

sections.heading: Limitations and Risks
sections.body:
Fortunately, significant complications from Breast implants are infrequent. Minor complications occur occasionally but do not affect the outcome. Major Breast implants complications are very unusual. Some of the potential complications are:

- Adverse reaction to anesthesia
- Hematoma or seroma
- Infection and bleeding
- Changes in sensation
- Capsular contracture
- Implant rupture

sections.heading: Implants and ALCL
sections.body:
The USFDA and the Institute of Medicine still believe that Breast implants are fairly safe and effective. In rare cases, women with Breast implants may be at an increased risk of BI-ALCL. This is not chest cancer and neither is it a cancer of the chest tissue. It is cancer arising in the capsule of the implant and is a very rare type of non-Hodgkins lymphoma. This can be easily detected and is highly treatable in the majority. Women with Breast implant should continue their routine chest examinations as recommended for other women.

- Unhappy about breasts being too large.

sections.heading: Cons:

sections.heading: What are the types of Breast reductions one can have?
sections.body:
The procedures of Breast reduction vary from patient to patient based on their unique needs. To provide effective and result-oriented breast reduction by Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya, our surgeon ensures to choose the right type. Although liposuction is performed in almost all breast reduction, it is used as an adjunctive procedure rather than the mainstay of treatment is usually used to reduce the fat component of the breasts and the sides. Alone liposuction will only benefit females where they have a substantial fat component in their breasts. This usually happens with post-menopausal women.

- Doughnut Incision: This is also called the peri-areolar approach. Again this is of limited use and pertains to only certain types of breasts.
- Lollipop incision: The lollipop incision is the most common method now used in breasts reduction worldwide. It has an incision around the areola and a line running vertically downwards from the areola to the breast crease.
- Anchor incision: In very large breast often anchor incision is utilized to give a pleasing shape to the breasts. This has an incision around the areola, vertically downwards to the crease and along the breasts crease.

sections.heading: I am really concerned about the scars.

Although initially the scars do look prominent it fade away gradually. breast is one of the tissues where the scars really fade away over time and are discernible on very very close observation. The advantages that are got with the procedure outweigh the presence of scars multiple times. However, if one has a tendency of keloids and pigmented scars then one must bring it to the notice of the Plastic Surgeon.

sections.heading: Post-operative recovery at home

- You should wear a supportive garment for your breasts so that the breasts heal properly.
- You must have the medications as prescribed by your surgeon and visit as called.
- Stitch line care: Keep your stitch line as dry as possible. Normally dressings come off in a week.

sections.heading: When should one consider a tummy tuck?
sections.body:
- Excess loose skin, flab and stretch marks in the lower part of the tummy that is unresponsive to exercise and weight loss measures

sections.heading: Types of Abdominoplasty
sections.body: A consultation with a certified plastic surgeon will give a clearer idea about the kind of procedure most suited to your case. A brief description of the types of abdominoplasty is given below:

sections.heading: 1. Full Abdominoplasty
sections.body: In this type, an incision is made on the lower part of the abdomen (approximately at the level of the cesarean section scar which is generally hidden in the bikini line) and in addition, there is a scar around the umbilicus. The skin below the navel is removed, The abdominal muscles are tightened and the skin envelope is tightened too by the removal of the skin. Liposuction is generally a part of this procedure which helps in further contouring of the abdomen. This helps to get rid of most of the stretch marks that are present in the abdomen.

sections.heading: 2. Mini Abdominoplasty
sections.body: This type has only a single incision in the pubic area which is usually made as low on the abdomen as possible. Excess skin is removed through this. This may or may not include tightening of the muscles and uses liposuction to further shape up the area. Ideally suited for women or men who have a laxity of skin limited to the lower part of the abdomen. Recommended for those who are in fairly good shape but cannot achieve their goals with diet and exercise.

sections.heading: 3. Extended or High Lateral Tension Abdominoplasty
sections.body: This usually is an extension of a full abdominoplasty and it takes care of the excess skin present on the sides and looseness that occurs in the hips and thighs due to massive weight loss or pregnancy. This procedure offers an improvement in the shape of the thighs and hips in addition to the improvement in the abdominal contour. The lift is also transferred to the sides by high-tension stitches that are put to suspend the thigh to improve contour in this area.

sections.heading: Precaution Before Surgery
sections.body:
Having outlined the above, it is safe to say that if you have an ideal body weight, are in good general health and if you have realistic expectations then you are a good candidate for the procedure.

- You should have a stable weight before you opt for this procedure
- If you are a smoker you likely to have a compromised healing than non-smokers. It is best to quit smoking at least 2 weeks prior to and till two months after the procedure.
- If you have a significant amount of intra-abdominal fat, then it is best that you lose weight and then consider this procedure.
- It is best if you have completed your family when you consider this procedure because subsequent child birth may affect the results.
- If you have a scar from a previous surgery (other than a cesarean section) then you must discuss the outcome of the procedure with your surgeon.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body:
In this surgical procedure the loose skin is removed and the muscles of the abdomen are tightened with the help of sutures. This procedure is carried out under general anesthesia. You will need to be fasting for eight hours and will need to get an anesthetic clearance prior to the procedure.

- Marking and measurements will be done before the procedure.
- After the necessary preoperative steps, the incision will be placed according to the marking and usually the incision is from one side of the hip bone to the other.
- In a full abdominoplasty an additional incision is paced around the navel.
- The skin envelope is lifted and the loose muscles are tightened.
- Liposuction is usually done prior to the lifting of the skin envelope and also after the tightening of the muscles.
- The skin is then stretched and the excess skin is removed.
- The navel then is brought out through a new position on the skin although the level of the navel remains the same.
- The skin is stitched with sutures which are generally the absorbable type. The umbilicus is stitched with non-absorbable sutures which are removed around the 12th day after the surgery.
- There is usually a drain or two that are placed under the skin to drain out the excess fluid. Depending on the amount of drainage they will be removed once the drainage is in the acceptable range which is usually one or two days.
- In combination with abdominoplasty if one opts for a back liposuction, the resulting contours are better if proper patient selection is done.

sections.heading: Aftercare and Recovery
sections.body:
It is good to point out at the outset that this phase varies greatly among patients depending on how well one can endure pain and discomfort post the procedure.

A compression garment needs to be worn for about a month after the procedure.

You will usually be advised plenty of rest after the procedure. Although it is not uncommon for patients to be up and walking right on the next day of the procedure but you will be instructed to bend and walk for the first few days because straightening up immediately will put tension on the stitch line. However, things normalize greatly after the passage of 4-5 days. The first few days after the surgery are the most uncomfortable. You will generally receive a list of instructions to follow after the procedure which will include the medications that you should be taking for about a week.

Usually one is most comfortable taking one week to ten days off work. This will also vary between a full and a mini abdominoplasty.

This gain varies between individuals. In the first week, the priority is to gain back mobility and take necessary steps to avoid complications. Managing pain is also a priority. The following weeks are concentrated on regaining mobility and getting back to routine work. Light exercises can generally be started after 8 weeks of the surgery. The healing really keeps on happening till about six to 8 months and the scar in some individuals may take longer to settle (around 1 year).

Unless one gains a large amount of weight or goes through another pregnancy that stretches the skin again making it loose, the results are long term. Any Plastic surgery cannot stop the aging that happens naturally but the tightening of the abdomen is permanent with a tummy tuck. After a certain period of time the skin will become softer and more pliable than immediately after the procedure. It is important to maintain a relationship with your aesthetic surgeon after a procedure and visit for prescribed follow ups to have a knowledge of your healing.

The potential complications after a tummy tuck are fortunately uncommon and the satisfaction rate is good. Most candidates achieve their goal of having a leaner and flatter abdomen.

However, it is necessary to point out that all surgical procedures have some risks, and although uncommon they are listed below:

- Adverse reaction to anesthesia
- Hematoma or seroma (an accumulation of blood or fluid under the skin that may require removal)
- Infection and bleeding
- Changes in skin sensation
- Scarring
- Allergic reactions
- Damage to underlying structures
- Unsatisfactory results that may necessitate additional procedures. One can lessen this risk greatly if one follows the instructions that are outlined by the surgeon.

Cost should not be the only criterion when one selects a surgeon. This is most likely a once in a lifetime procedure that one goes through, so adequate research should go down while selecting your surgeon.

Tummy tuck surgery is quite a popular surgery and the reason for it being popular is the advantages it offers as a procedure, which are:

sections.heading: Who is a candidate for a Hair Transplant?
sections.body: Any person who is suffering from chronic hair loss and has healthy donor hair is a good candidate for a hair transplant.

sections.heading: Is medication necessary before Hair transplant?
sections.body: If one is in good health then one can opt for a hair transplant directly. However, if one has a course of hair vitamins and Hair Booster Therapy then the donor and the recipient both areas improve thus improving the quality of the transplant. You can avail yourself of the benefits of these effective therapies and can get the best hair transplant at our centre.

sections.heading: Is there a non-surgical Hair transplant?
sections.body: There is no non-surgical hair transplant. The basis of hair transplant lies in the principles of Plastic Surgery. A free tissue taken from one part of the body and placed on another part of the body to derive blood supply from the recipient area is called a graft. Hair follicle grafts are taken from the back of the scalp most commonly and transplanted on the front, vault or temporal areas of hair loss to give coverage to the balding or bald areas. To learn about effective and the best hair transplant at our centre, book a consultation with our expert hair transplant surgeon now!

sections.heading: How about the scars? I have heard of scarless Hair transplant.
sections.body: There are typically two methods of hair transplant FUE and FUT. The FUT is the strip method and FUE is the extraction method which is marketed as a scarless technique. Our expert and the Best Doctor for Hair transplant utilizes advanced hair transplant techniques like FUE and Hair ART that are painless and leave minimal scarring.

sections.heading: What is the difference between the two methods?
sections.body:
FUE or follicular unit extraction method is where the hair is taken from the donor area in the form of small grafts which are directly extracted by the use of a pen-like motor. The holes that occur after the extraction collapse in a few days time and get covered by the growing hair and become almost invisible to the naked eye. Thus this method is marketed by different hair transplant clinics as the scarless technique.

FUT is the follicular unit transplantation technique where a strip of the donor tissue is taken and the follicles from the strip are separated under the microscope for transplantation. The donor area is neatly stitched by the method of ‘Trichophytic closure’ and in a well-done case, the hair actually grows through the scar. Done in trained hands the results of FUT are better than the FUE technique because the scars of FUE will still be visible as dotted areas if the graft requirement is more.

To get the best results and a natural-looking hairline, book a consultation with the Best Doctor for Hair transplant, Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya.

sections.heading: My area of baldness is quite a lot, which method will be suitable?
sections.body: For areas of large baldness often a combination treatment of FUE and FUT may be required for optimizing the result. A lot of the hair transplant results will depend on the quality of the donor's hair. People who have thin donor hair may require more than one session of hair transplant to gain an adequate amount of coverage. One should book a consultation with a skilled hair transplant surgeon to get more details about this. Visit our centre to clear all your doubts by consulting with Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya, at a top hair transplant clinic.

sections.heading: What should I expect during my first visit to the hair transplant doctor?
sections.body: In your first visit, a careful history is noted down, Your habituations and addictions are noted and your co-morbidities are outlined as well. Your donor and recipient area are estimated. You will need a few investigations of blood to be done before your procedure is scheduled.

sections.heading: What should I expect on the day of the procedure?
sections.body:
You will need to shorten your hair for the graft to be harvested from the donor area. In the FUT method, only the strip area may need to be trimmed short and once the surrounding tissue is brought together after the strip is harvested the closing in of tissues and overlapping hair will hide the scar almost the very next day. However, you may trim your entire hair short for the ease of the procedure. After all, this donor area will grow back in about 7-10 days.

The procedure is carried out in an operating room set up where utmost care is taken about the sterility. Although this is a procedure carried out under local anesthesia completely, the centre carrying out the hair transplant should be equipped to handle any emergency that may arise from the situation. It is in your best interest that you keep in mind your safety while undertaking the procedure. The cheapest place may not be the best either in terms of the results or in terms of your safety.

Marking for the hairline will be done and some photographs will be taken. Then you will be shifted to the actual area of the procedure.

sections.heading: How is local anesthesia administered?
sections.body: Local anesthesia is administered by tiny injections in the scalp. A lot of fluid is usually used during the procedure but once the effect of local anesthesia kicks in, you will not be able to feel anything that is being done during the procedure. The hair transplant doctor and the team members keep augmenting the anesthesia in between to keep the area anesthetized so that the procedure is completed without pain.

sections.heading: How much time is required to harvest the grafts?
sections.body:
In FUT the harvesting of the strip and the stitching of the area will require just about 45 minutes after which you will usually be sent to rest for a while till the team will harvest the hair grafts from the strips.

In FUE however, because the grafts are harvested directly from the scalp you should know that the time required will depend upon the number of grafts to be harvested and can take anywhere between 1 hour to 4 hours.

Slits will be made for placement of the grafts. Then grafts that have been harvested will then be placed in their slits. A break is given in between the procedure so that one doesn’t feel tired during the procedure. One can expect that the procedure will last about 6-8 hours but this too will depend upon the number of grafts that are needed to be done.

sections.heading: Will I need to stay in the hospital overnight?
sections.body: No hospital stay is needed after the procedure and one can leave about half an hour after the procedure is completed. You will require to have some oral medications at home after this.

sections.heading: What to expect after my Hair transplant?
sections.body: One should expect to come back for a hair transplant- clinic hair wash on the 4th day after the procedure. Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya focuses that all her patients follow proper pre-and-post care guidelines. This is necessary to make the recovery journey easy and to get the maximum results. Thus, the best hair transplant doctor will advise you about the medications and post-procedure care that you will need to take.

sections.heading: When can I return to normal activity?
sections.body: Regular day to day activities can be started after a day of the procedure. No bed rest is required however a couple of days off work would be recommended. You can expect some swelling on the forehead and around the eyes that usually subside in 2-3 days time. Exercises will need to be withheld for about 3 weeks after the procedure. At the clinic, the doctor will tell the patient about a proper set of guidelines which will include advice on when to return to work.

sections.heading: Can I take growth factor therapy after my Hair Transplant?
sections.body: Growth factor therapies after the hair transplant are usually recommended and they lead to stronger hair growth by supplying the new hair roots with essential nutrients and growth factors. Typically three sessions are recommended for optimum benefit. You should also continue to take your oral vitamins after the transplant.

sections.heading: When will I see new Hair Growth?
sections.body: The hairs that are transplanted usually fall off in about 2-4 week's time and new hair growth is visible only in the 3rd or 4th month. The hairs continue to show new growth till about 8 or 9 months.

sections.heading: If I need a second session for density, when should I go for it?
sections.body: One can have a repeat procedure anytime after six months of the initial procedure.

sections.heading: I don’t have enough hair for transplant on my scalp, what can be done?
sections.body: Body hair transplant can be done for people who do not have enough scalp hair, however, one should have realistic expectations from the procedure when considering this.

sections.body: Laser hair reduction is a revolutionary hair removal method that can be used to get rid of unwanted hair on hairy parts of the face and body.

sections.heading: Benefits of laser hair reduction
sections.body:
- Virtually painless, advanced hair removal method
- Minimal side effects

- Can get rid of unwanted hair in case of medical conditions like PCOS, hirsutism, and hypertrichosis

sections.heading: Procedure Preparation
sections.body: The targetted area for hair removal is trimmed/shaved and a cooling gel is applied to the area to prevent heat injury from the laser light. Special devices with cooling tip may also be used to achieve the same.

sections.heading: How does a laser work in reducing unwanted hair growth?
sections.body: Lasers emit an intense light beam of a specific wavelength that gets absorbed by the melanin of the actively growing targeted hair. The light energy heats the melanin and subsequently thermally damages the concerned tissues without harming the surrounding healthy skin. sections.heading: How is Power Shot beneficial for Skin and Hair Rejuvenation?
sections.body:
The growth factors present in power shots can deeply rejuvenate the skin. These can act both superficially and deeply to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, hyperpigmentation spots, and acne scars. Power shot anti-aging treatment in Delhi NCR can help boost collagen production in the skin and provide refreshing, glowing, and naturally healthy skin. Collagen is a skin structural protein that can help tighten the skin, diminish open/large pores, and make the skin look youthful.

To get the benefits of this amazing skin brightening treatment in Delhi NCR, contact Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya. The treatment is a top trend for many people who want to add volume and an intense glow to their face. Visit now for more insights!

When a power shot is superficially administered to hair roots, it strengthens the hair roots, improves blood circulation, and encourages hair growth. Moreover, it promotes the thickening of every hair follicle, thereby improving hair texture.

Power shot is also an amazing alopecia and hair fall control treatment. Visit Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya if you are experiencing hair thinning, a receding hairline, alopecia, or hair loss, and manage all these with power shot treatment.

sections.heading: What to expect in a Power Shot treatment?
sections.body:
Preparation of growth factors - Firstly, the patient’s blood, just about 30-40 mL, is drawn out from his/her arm using a sterile syringe and equally transferred in sterile 3 or 4 vials. These vials, containing the blood and platelet-activating solution, are then placed in a centrifuge machine. The vials are double centrifuged to get pure concentrated natural growth factors released by blood platelets.

Typically, the colour of growth factors prepared by the standard method is pinkish. On average, the duration of preparation of growth factors is about 45 minutes. Till then, the treatment site is numbed with local anaesthesia.

Drop by Drop injecting of prepared growth factors - After the growth factor concentrate is prepared, the treatment area is properly cleaned with an anti-bacterial solution to avoid infections. Next, the treatment site is covered from all sides with a sterile cloth. Then, the prepared growth factors are delivered into the area via microneedling or injected using very small, sterile needles.

The use of microneedling in this therapy is highly beneficial as it increases the absorption of growth factors into the target area, thereby enhancing the desired effects of the therapy by many folds.

To get the benefits of this amazing anti-aging and best hair loss control treatment in Delhi NCR, book a visit with Dr Sharmistha Bhattacharyya today!

sections.body:
- Refrain from scrubbing, touching, or rubbing the treated area for a few hours.

sections.heading: How many sessions will I need for Power Shot?
sections.body: You will require multiple sessions to attain and keep the desired results for the long term. Usually, optimal results are obtained in three sessions, performed with a gap of 4-6 weeks.

sections.heading: Does a power shot hurt?
sections.body: Power Shot treatment is performed on an anaesthetised site, so the procedure is comfortable throughout. Usually, the pain score given by patients who have received growth factors via microneedling is 2/10, and the pain score by those who have got growth factors instilled with small needles is 1/10. Whatever may be the procedure, the pain is tolerable and minimal. However, after the effect of anaesthesia wears off, the patient could expect mild to moderate discomfort at the injection site for a few days.

sections.heading: Are there any side effects of Power Shot?
sections.body: Power shot treatment is extremely safe with minimal to no side effects. That’s because there is no use of chemicals, but instead the use of the patient's blood that can help naturally regenerate the damaged cells of the skin and hair. However, patients can experience mild, temporary side effects such as pain, irritation, swelling, or bleeding at or around the site of injection.

sections.heading: How long does the effect of Power Shot last?
sections.body:
Typically, the longevity of the results depends upon factors like age, duration, cause of hair loss, and the extent of the skin/hair problem. Power Shot is neither a cure for hair loss nor a lifetime solution for ageing skin. The desired effects of the Power Shot treatment on the skin can last for up to 18 months, and restored hair could last for up to a year.

This means multiple power shot sessions would be needed to maintain the results. For keeping hair loss under control, the doctor suggests maintenance of Power shots every 3-6 months, and for maintaining younger-looking skin, Power shot treatment twice a year is often enough.

The candidates suitable for Power shot therapy are:

- People who hold realistic expectations to achieve subtle, natural results.
- Individuals without any serious illnesses or active skin infections/allergies.
- Non-smokers.
- Non-pregnant or lactating women.

faq.q: Are breast implants safe and do they cause cancer?
faq.a: Breast implants approved by regulatory authorities (US FDA and Indian CDSCO) have a long safety track record. They do not increase the risk of breast cancer. Rare conditions like BIA-ALCL are extremely uncommon and thoroughly screened. Implants do not prevent breastfeeding or regular mammography screening.

faq.q: Is hair transplant painful and how long does it take?
faq.a: Hair transplant is performed entirely under local anesthesia, meaning the scalp is completely numb and the procedure is painless. You can watch movies or read during graft placement. faq.q: What is the difference between Liposuction and a Tummy Tuck?
faq.a: Liposuction removes localized, stubborn fat deposits where the skin has good elasticity. It does not tighten loose skin or repair separated abdominal muscles. A Tummy Tuck (abdominoplasty) removes excess sagging skin, tightens separated rectus abdominal muscles (diastasis recti), and repositions the belly button, often combined with liposuction of the flanks.
